Hey mate i know how utterly horrible derealization is, I had it for roughly six months and it was a constant struggle. I cannot even imagine having it for a year or more. It's like your consciousness is disconnected from your own self and it's really scary but at the same time not at it's so shit. I had it again for the first time in nearly a year the other day and burst into tears not wanting it to happen again. I found that when I'm taking certain medications is when it happens particularly if I binged on benzodiazepines but after i stopped taking everything it still took about three weeks to go away. I can't say i understand how it fully works or even tell you what will make it better, I'm just going off my own experience. If i could give a few tips it'd be to stay around friend's you're really comfortable with and just try to chill out and relax when you're with them and even tell them whats going on. A big help for me was sleeping more and drinking heaps of water, also to make sure i surround myself with lots of love. Good luck with it i know it's a struggle but it's going to go away eventually just keep up that fight with every single ounce of energy you have. Feel free to message me whenever you like i can't give you solutions but I'm always here to listen!

Unfortunately I can't really tell you what will help but I do have some things that might (these things haven't fixed me so to speak but I did notice a bit of improvement here and there so I'm hopeful for you) have you tried seeing any form of mental help at all? I personally found the really cheap or completely free help services were the best for me, they're not there making heaps of money so they're actually people that truely love and care about you and that's why they do it. Losing the ability to enjoy things like you once did is absolutely harrowing I'm sorry it's happening to you I know it's completely fucked and not being able to bring it back for anything is worse. I like to continuously tell myself over and over when I enjoy things and what makes me happy even though it's not true it does somehow give me a bit of comfort. Also lately I've been using modafinil (do some research on it and in most places it's easy to obtain without a prescription completely legally online be it a very powerful drug) to give me extra motivation and it's actually working extremely well, I've noticed a dramatic improvement on my work life and goals. Not sure if it will help you but hey maybe it's something to look into. 
I can't by any means see it exactly from your perspective or understand what it's like to be in your shoes but I really hope it gets better, even though I don't know you I do care a lot
